_help: Starter contract for a mutation-testing gate: the suite must pass AND kill every mutant mutmut introduces into the target package (a stronger signal than coverage — coverage only proves a line RAN, not that a test would catch a bug in it). Build the second verifier with `--verify-mutation src --verify-mutation-tests-dir tests` instead of hand-editing it. Requires pytest-cov (pip install "mutmut>=2.4,<3" — pin below 3.x, verified to segfault). Linux only for now: mutmut opens a PTY that macOS Seatbelt denies (verified live); works under bwrap. Edit 'goal' and the target package, then: loophole run --contract loophole.json
